m3-census.title: Full census walk to trends.json, gross-not-net, determinism-checked
m3-census.imperative: Walk every commit touching skills/ (git rev-list --reverse HEAD -- skills/) unioned explicitly with the tagged off-line baselines (they are NOT ancestors of main; a rev-list walk will never visit them). One row per landed change. Per interval emit gross-added AND gross-deleted separately, per bin — a net-only row is a defect. Report roles entering/leaving the window separately from deletion (a role's death is an org change, NEVER deletion pressure); role lineage is hand-authored data. git log --follow is forbidden. Write trends.json. Run the instrument twice at the same HEAD and confirm byte-identical output; non-identical is VOID.

postconditions.statement: commit-count enumeration asserted from a command (184 touching skills/ + explicit baseline union), and the union is shown to add the off-line baselines
postconditions.satisfied_by: ENUMERATION ASSERTED FROM COMMANDS. git rev-list --count HEAD -- skills/ = 184. Both tagged baselines confirmed ABSENT from that walk by grep against the walk output, so both are unioned in explicitly. HEAD (9a90298) is ALSO absent from the walk because HEAD itself touches no skills/ file - unioned in as the measurement endpoint with on_main_line=false so it is never counted as one of the n changes. 184 + 3 unioned = 187 census rows, matching counts.census_rows=187.

postconditions.statement: trends.json built and two consecutive runs at the same HEAD are byte-identical (determinism)

why_trail.why: All eight handoff fields present: task, protected intent, constraints(9), method(a-g), allowed scope, exclusions, verification commands, stop conditions, return format. PRE_REGISTRATION binding read; TREND_SNAPSHOT baseline read. Tags resolve: baseline/304-trend-snapshot^{commit}=fc1685a, baseline/304-g2-approve^{commit}=a8d9467 (annotated tags - bare rev-parse gives the tag object, not the commit).

ORACLE REPRODUCES at tag baseline/304-trend-snapshot (=fc1685a): 19/15831/100/63681 exact, roles=19. Decoyed twice: --at baseline/304-g2-approve exits 1 (corpus_words 63849), --at HEAD exits 1 (15858/63781). Finding: the published 63,681 is a CONCATENATED count; the per-file sum is 63,682, because exactly one file (skills/commander/templates/COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json) lacks a trailing newline and its last word fuses with the next file's first. Both are emitted. HEAD figures independently match the Commander-verified 15,858 / 63,781.

Bins partition exactly (100 files at HEAD = 19 NARROW + 21 WIDE-EXTRA + 60 CONDITIONAL). 10 unresolved reference tokens at HEAD, all cross-role citations (9x workbench/checklist-engine.md, 1x commander/commander-core.md); all 10 targets are already in WIDE-EXTRA via their owning role, so uncovered count = 0 and WIDE is not under-counted at corpus level. Consequence of the Admiral rule flagged: _shared/windows.md and _shared/skill-goodness.md are shipped by the installer into every role but named by no SKILL.md, so they land in CONDITIONALLY-LOADED. 29 fixture tests pass; suite proven able to fail by mutating the oracle constant (1 failed, 28 passed), mutation asserted applied before running.

Census built: 187 rows, 186 intervals, 234 deletion events corpus-wide, 3 in the baseline..HEAD window. KEY: #304's squash-merge 5d2585b is a ZERO-DELTA row - skills/ tree OID identical to the baseline's (caefc5d5), verified by git rev-parse independently of the instrument - so the n=2-vs-3 judgement call has ZERO measurement consequence. origin/main and HEAD share skills/ tree 93aa92e, so this HEAD measurement IS the Commander's origin/main measurement.

H1 FALSIFIED (NARROW takes 43.9% of deletion pressure corpus-wide, 54.4% post-regime - deletion falls HARDEST on the bin B2 worries about, and still loses to growth there at 1.70:1 add:delete). H2 CONFIRMED including the per-role-mean caveat (305->835 w/role). H3 CONFIRMED for the current corpus (4/7 panel revisions; the 3 non-reversal revisions predate docent's birth). (e) NO TREND COMPUTABLE: n=2-or-3 over 22.3h, window NARROW movement +27w is below the p25 (35w) of routine per-interval movement and 81% of moving intervals moved more. R3 and R5 fire; R1 and R2 BOTH fail on their own terms, which the pre-registration did not anticipate. Kernel break left to Tommy.
